collection.title: Citroen Berlingo Tailgate Rear Door 1996 to 2007 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Citroen Berlingo 1996 to 2007 model requires a 22" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 21" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, there is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade. We also have rear blades for this Berlingo, simply click on the Rear Blades tab below.
